goal: react-doctor product-code score >= 90 with zero UI/UX regressions
scoring_note: Score is density-based: removing files/issues proportionally barely moves it. Reaching 90 requires clearing most of the 607 product diagnostics. Re-measure after every phase.
verification_gate: playwright-cli e2e across Blink/Gecko/WebKit + mobile on touched surfaces

items.description: Fix react-doctor config so only test files are excluded (ignore.overrides), single canonical doctor.config.json
items.notes: Committed 928784aa3. ignore.files is broken in rd 0.4.0; overrides works. Baseline 55, not 54.

items.description: Phase 1 safe bulk: delete compiler-redundant memo in non-bailout files (166) + barrel imports (39) + hoists/pure-fn/deprecated/simple-memo (~11). One agent per file.
items.notes: Skip memo with side-effect factory or memo() custom comparator. Low regression risk.

items.description: Phase 2 compiler bailouts (errors): refs(37), set-state-in-effect(13), todo(14), preserve-manual-memoization(7), immutability(2), hooks(1), purity(1). Fix so files compile, then delete the 117 now-unlocked memo.
items.notes: Behavioral risk - smaller batches, careful verification.

items.description: Phase 3 behavioral state bugs: no-adjust-state-on-prop-change(17), no-event-handler(30), no-pass-data-to-parent(7), prefer-useReducer(4), derived/cascading/chain state, exhaustive-deps, etc.
Phase 4 structural: no-multi-comp(35), no-giant-component(12), no-many-boolean-props(12), no-render-in-render(4).
items.notes: Component splits - UI layout regression risk.

items.description: Phase 5 a11y + careful perf: media-has-caption(5), js-* perf refactors(~30), async-await-in-loop(13), rerender-lazy-ref-init(7), etc. Only as needed to reach 90.
items.notes: async-* changes sequential->parallel semantics - verify carefully.
